editorial.evidence: 16 November 2026: read all 44 captured sections of the maths-model source and built a 77-row item inventory before drafting. The source states most mechanisms three times (Interview Guide, Deep Dive, Full Design) at different depths; each was merged once at its fullest version: the two clarifying-question tables into step 1, the main requirements block and full-pack section 2 into step 2, deep dive 3 and full-pack 9 into the compute deep dive, deep dive 4 split into evaluation, harm and phone deep dives with full-pack 10 and 11. The brief opens on the 94%/78% leakage story because it is the case's dangerous constraint, defines thirteen training terms the source used undefined (rollout, verifier, drift penalty, pass@1, decontamination, KV cache, etc.), and adds a labelled illustrative pencils word-problem trace that is reused in steps 7 and the eval deep dive. Every source table is kept row for row; all five diagram pairs (10 hashed SVGs) sit beside the step that explains them. All 12 Check Yourself items, 6 follow-ups, the compute pivot and the 3 mid-round constraint changes are worked-answer reveals (22). Removed one unsupported addition during review (a claim that majority vote usually scores higher). Old navigation (sections table, how-to-use, cheat-sheet links) is consolidated, not reproduced.
